# documented subcommand groups exist with expected verbs (README Commands tables)

# auth subcommands

stdout 'login'
stdout 'logout'
stdout 'status'

stdout 'add'
stdout 'remove'
stdout 'validate'

stdout 'pull'
stdout 'yank'
stdout 'unyank'

# config subcommands
